Pocket resume is what I open when I need a clean, print-ready view of my career story. The live page mirrors the structure of a polished resume—experience, projects, highlights—so it looks perfect on-screen and when exported to PDF. It knows exactly what to emphasize without extra navigation because the entire layout is a single job-sheet that fits on one well-designed page.

If I want to keep a copy for myself or share it, I fill the form with the private details I care about (contact info, personal notes, extra project context). Those entries get added to the same page so the resume PDF contains the full story, no matter how much I tweak the supporting data. Every time I revisit, the resume is already formatted and ready to print or export with the latest information.
